mission: Torin's philosophy hardens — he uses the Valley's destabilization as evidence that the seal was always a temporary measure. His argument: the only permanent solution is someone who understands the technique becoming the new seal. Himself.
why_now: The widening crisis provides Torin with ammunition. His argument becomes harder to dismiss as the stakes rise.
conflict: Torin presents his position with devastating logic and genuine warmth. He's not trying to seize power — he's offering to sacrifice himself. The horror is in the nobility. This is Jacen's pattern wearing a better mask.
turning_point: Torin makes a devastating observation to Ben: 'You're curating reality to manage the outcome you want. You know who else did that?' — naming the pattern Ben is falling into with his withholding from Luke.
opening_hook: Torin brings it up over food. He always brings the worst things up over food — it's a disarming technique Ben is starting to recognize.
closing_hook: The observation about curating reality lands like a blade. Ben can't dismiss it because Torin is right — Ben IS withholding, controlling information, managing the narrative. The question is whether recognizing the pattern is enough to break it.
emotional_trajectory: Engaged debate -> seductive logic -> the devastating personal parallel

stakes.personal: Ben's own pattern of control exposed by the person repeating it at larger scale
stakes.interpersonal: Torin and Ben — mutual respect making the disagreement more painful
stakes.external: Torin's 'solution' would work but at the cost of everything the theme argues against

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — common area, meal time
sensory_details: Food cooling as the conversation heats; Torin's warmth slightly mechanical — the humor arriving on schedule; Sera's silence — she's heard this argument before, from Gavran; Ben's hands under the table, gripping his knees
notes: H15 planted — Torin's devastating observation about curating reality. This names the Jacen pattern before Ben formally recognizes it in Chapter 18. Torin's arc: lie_deepened — his certainty growing as the crisis validates his analysis.
